## Orbit Time v1.3

### What's new
- 🌍 Organization-wide holidays — holidays added by the Holiday Manager apply to every employee.
- 📊 Reports gains an Overtime section: total, overtime days and average per overtime day.
- 🔔 Smarter notifications — missed and late attendance follow the same day status as Daily History, so leave days, holidays and week-offs are never reported as missed.
- 🛠️ Home, Punch and Reports count days exactly as Daily History does — a past holiday is no longer counted as an absence — and worked time shows minutes.
- ⏰ The shift reminder no longer fires on leave days, holidays or week-offs.

### Update fix
- ⬆️ The previous "v.1.3" download actually contained version 1.2, so installing it changed nothing and the update was offered again. This release is a genuine 1.3 build (versionCode 3), and the app now checks a downloaded update's version before installing it.
